'''Chapter 1160''' is titled "The God Valley Incident".

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]], Vol. 42: "The shrine to [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] and his [[Nine Red Scabbards|companions]] overlooking the [[Flower Capital]]"

==Short Summary==
After members of the [[Davy Family]] are revealed, the [[World Noble]]s begin the [[Native Hunting Competition]] to hunt down their targets throughout [[God Valley]]. The competition is disrupted by the arrival of the [[Rocks Pirates]], [[Roger Pirates]], and several other pirate ships. During the chaos, [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] attempts to get [[Shanks]] and [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]] off of God Valley. The [[Knights of God]] begin to take action and prepare for battle. While the [[Marines]] are being attacked, [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] and his fleet arrive to take on the pirates.

==Long Summary==
It turns out there were several other members of the [[Davy Family|Davy clan]] residing on [[God Valley]] aside from Teach, and once they were presented to the [[World Noble|World Nobles]], they all started yelling hateful things about them, claiming that they are the most despised of all people and that they are connected to the [[Buccaneers]]. They all started to throw weapons at them only for the announcer to tell everyone to hold their fire or they will get penalized. [[Jaygarcia Saturn|Saturn]] commended [[Figarland Garling|Garling]] for discovering the Davy clan on the island, which is why he recommended it as the staging ground for the tournament, but he merely called it an act of fate. Elsewhere, [[Magnolia|Shanks and Shamrock's mother]] told [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] that she wants him to make sure her children are raised as kindhearted people, and not let Garling corrupt them. As she dies, Dragon swears he will find her children and save them and takes off. The event finally begins and all of the targets start running, hoping they can survive for three weeks and escape for their lives.

Once the World Nobles start their hunt, it is shown that no one, not even infants or children, were spared from their depravity. On top of that, the entire event was televised to [[Mary Geoise]], where the other World Nobles watching cheered on the rest of their ilk and making bets, with one of them mentioning [[Manmayer Gunko|Gunko]] as the pet devoted "Blade of God" as she strikes down several people with her powers. [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]], meanwhile, chased a boy up into a tree and left his thorns beneath it for him to fall on. The boy's father sees him and tries to rescue him, only for both to be impaled on the thorns, to Sommers' enjoyment.

Dragon witnesses the dead bodies of the hunted people and gets sick, but he knows that if he defies the World Nobles then his entire platoon will be slaughtered in retaliation. However, he sees a World Noble preparing to shoot [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]] while he was listening to [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov's]] speech, and when he saw they still had hope, he ended up tranquilizing the noble, to his own personal worry. Just then, the [[Rocks Pirates]] finally make landfall.

[[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] tells his crew that until they rescue [[Shakuyaku|Shakky]] and claim the [[Devil Fruit|Devil Fruits]] and other treasure, they should not infight until they divvy up the rewards evenly. [[Barbel]] points out that they cannot split up Shakky because she is a person, so [[Shiki]] says that she will fall in love with whoever rescues her first. [[John]] says she will fall for who gets the most treasure, but [[Charlotte Linlin|Linlin]] says that no matter how much chaos they cause, she will not pay attention to them. Humorously, [[Edward Newgate|Newgate]] says he wants to rescue her as a friend, but would not be opposed to her falling for him, to [[Buckingham Stussy|Buckin's]] annoyance, while [[Gloriosa]] ponders if [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] would be grateful to her if she rescued Shakky. [[Streusen]] mentions that [[Ochoku]] chose to stay on [[Hachinosu]] and wonders if Shakky will ban him from her bar for life for his cowardice, and [[Kaidou]] simply asks if Linlin will get him a good Devil Fruit.

As the Rocks Pirates start rampaging, the World Nobles start fleeing in terror as Garling laments that the game has ended early because of them. As the [[Roger Pirates]] are announced to have arrived, Dragon manages to find the twins in the chaos and starts running off with them. Once the Roger Pirates make landfall, Roger tells everyone that he is going to rescue Shakky and no one else will have a shot, so they should just take the treasure, only to be ignored and trampled. The [[Knights of God]] take the stage to protect the World Nobles while the [[Marines]] are ordered to pull back. Just then, [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] arrives on the scene and starts blasting away other pirates who heard the news, while the Marines cheer him on.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*Before the [[Native Hunting Competition]] begins, members of the [[Davy Family]] are presented to the [[World Noble]]s.
*[[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] agrees to save [[Shanks]] and [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]] at [[Magnolia|their mother]]'s request.
**In the ensuing chaos, Dragon manages to run away with Shanks and Shamrock in his arms.
*The [[Bavette Family]] is first mentioned.
*During the competition, Dragon tranquilizes a World Noble who tried to shoot an unsuspecting [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]].
*The [[Rocks Pirates]] arrive at [[God Valley]] and split up to save [[Shakuyaku]] and acquire the treasure.
**[[Streusen]] confirms that [[Ochoku]] stayed behind at [[Hachinosu]].
*The [[Roger Pirates]] make landfall as well.
**Though [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] wants to save Shakuyaku by himself, he is trampled by his own overeager crew.
*Garling mobilizes all the [[Knights of God]] to fight the pirates.
*More and more pirate crews arrive at the island, overwhelming the [[Marines]].
*[[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] arrives as well to save his troops, immediately attracting the attention of Roger and Rocks.
